transactions.citation: p392 (highlights): 'DPU-accretive acquisition of 98.47% effective interest in Tokyo Data Centre 1, a hyperscale data centre, for JPY 23.0 billion'; p6331/p7171: 'On 31 July 2024, Keppel DC REIT completed the acquisition of 98.47% effective interest in Tokyo DC 1, located in West Tokyo, Japan'
transactions.notes: Purchase price of JPY23,042.0m (p2873) converted/reported in the AR at S$194.2m (per our prior extraction's raw.purchase_price_local); JPY figure is the source-disclosed local-currency amount. interest_pct is the 98.47% effective interest acquired (not a multi-tranche stake build).

transactions.counterparty: TPM Pte. Ltd. and Geras DC Pte. Ltd. (via subscription for securities issued by Memphis 1 Pte. Ltd.)
transactions.citation: p2040-2042: 'Keppel DC REIT acquiring 49% of the shares of Memphis 1 Pte. Ltd. ... and subscribing to two new classes of securities ... entitling Keppel DC REIT to 99.49% of the economic interest in KDC SGP 7 and 8. The agreed aggregated property value of S$1,030.0 million (if there is no Land Tenure Lease Extension)'; p7171: completed 27 Dec 2024
transactions.notes: purchase_price uses the agreed aggregate property value EXCLUDING the optional Land Tenure Lease Extension (S$1,030.0m); WITH the 10-year extension the agreed value rises to S$1,380.0m (extension consideration ~S$350m, disclosed separately, p165) — not included here since the extension was not exercised/paid as part of this completed deal. Structured as a 99.49% economic-interest acquisition via securities in Memphis 1 Pte. Ltd., which holds the two properties; Keppel DC REIT also holds a call option (Nov 2024) for the remaining 51% share stake, unexercised at FY2024 year-end (p8462).

transactions.counterparty: Macquarie Data Centres Macquarie Park Property SubTrust Pty Ltd
transactions.citation: p236: 'we unlocked A$174.0 million from the opportunistic divestment of Intellicentre Campus in Sydney at a 35.4% premium over valuation'; p1940: 'The Manager opportunistically divested IC DC in Australia at 35.4% premium to valuation to unlock value'
transactions.notes: gain_loss_pct is AR-DISCLOSED (35.4%), not derived. Sale price A$174.0m; implied valuation base = 174.0/1.354 ≈ A$128.5m, matching our prior extraction's valuation figure (A$128.5m as at 31 Dec 2023). This is a PROPERTY-LEVEL premium-to-valuation figure per the schema convention; the separate ACCOUNTING gain booked in the financial statements is S$31,611k ('Gain on divestment of an investment property', p3745/p6146), net of withholding tax S$17,028k (p6393) — that SGD accounting figure is NOT stored here (it mixes FX translation and is on a different basis/currency than the AUD property-level premium); recorded per spec's 'equity/property sales recorded on property economics, not accounting outcome' convention. Part of A$174.0m proceeds (A$90.0m) reinvested into an Australia Data Centre Note (p236) — no bearing on the divestment economics itself.

transactions.property_name: Basis Bay Data Centre (Basis Bay DC)
transactions.citation: p517/p528: 'Divestment of asset announced on 2 January 2025; completion expected in 3Q 2025'
transactions.notes: Announced but not completed as at FY2024 year-end (announced 2 Jan 2025, a subsequent event); no sale price disclosed in FY2024 AR, so gain_loss_pct cannot be derived. Property was reclassified to investment property held for sale at carrying value S$16,520k (per prior extraction _notes.json anomalies) — this is a carrying value, not a transacted price, so left out of reference_value to avoid implying a completed deal. deal_id uses 2025 (the year completion is expected), consistent with spec's 'year deal completed' rule; will need reconciling if completion lands in FY2025 AR under a different date.
